Type: botanical print cushion
Use: on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, mid-century modern, bohemian
Materials: woven cotton fabric with a printed pattern
Colors: off-white background, charcoal, grey, sand beige, black

Feel: natural, calm, lively
